# @zakkster/lite-headless/time-picker

createTimePicker(options) -> TimePickerHandle

Headless time entry from ARIA spinbutton SEGMENTS: an hour segment, a minute
segment, and (in 12-hour locales) a meridiem segment. The consumer provides
the segment elements; the primitive wires
aria-valuenow/valuemin/valuemax/valuetext, ArrowUp/Down spin-with-wrap, and
digit typeahead (consecutive digits accumulate within a short window, then
clamp -- the pin-input precedent).

NON-OVERLAY primitive. Ships aria id helpers only. A popover / dropdown around
the segments is a docs-level composition (exactly as the datepicker documents
pairing with a popover); the overlay layers are deliberately NOT pulled in.

hour12 is resolved ONCE, at construction: an explicit `hour12` option wins,
otherwise it is derived from Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions() a single
time. Never re-derived per event.

## Options

- value: WriteSignal<{hour,minute}>     -- external controlled value (24h hour)
- defaultValue: {hour,minute} | null    -- uncontrolled seed (24h hour)
- onValueChange({hour,minute}, reason)  -- reason: 'spin'|'typeahead'|'meridiem'
                                        --  |'home-end'|'slot'|'set'|'api'
- hour12: boolean                        -- override the Intl-derived clock
- minuteStep: number = 1                 -- ArrowUp/Down minute increment
- hourStep: number = 1                   -- ArrowUp/Down hour increment
- ariaLabel: string = 'Time'
- ariaLabelHour: string = 'Hour'
- ariaLabelMinute: string = 'Minute'
- ariaLabelMeridiem: string = 'AM/PM'
- typeaheadTimeout: number = 900         -- ms before the digit buffer resets

## Returned

{
    hour(): number,                      -- 0..23 (reactive)
    minute(): number,                    -- 0..59 (reactive)
    meridiem(): 'AM'|'PM',               -- derived (reactive)
    value(): { hour, minute },           -- 24h snapshot
    hour12: boolean,                     -- resolved clock convention

    setValue({hour,minute}, reason),
    setHour(h24, reason),
    setMinute(m, reason),
    spinHour(delta),                     -- wraps 0<->23
    spinMinute(delta),                   -- wraps 0<->59 by minuteStep
    toggleMeridiem(reason),              -- 12h only; +/-12h

    attachHourSegment(el),               -- role=spinbutton
    attachMinuteSegment(el),             -- role=spinbutton
    attachMeridiem(el),                  -- role=spinbutton (no-op in 24h mode)
    attachSlotList(el),                  -- optional role=listbox
    attachSlot(el, { hour, minute }),    -- optional role=option
    destroy(),
    destroyed
}

## Keyboard model (per segment)

  ArrowUp / ArrowDown         spin the segment value (wraps)
  Home / End                  jump to min / max (hour + minute segments)
  0-9                         digit typeahead: "1" then "2" -> 12; clamps to max
  a / p                       meridiem segment: set AM / PM

## Segment ARIA

- hour segment:     role=spinbutton, aria-valuemin/valuemax = 1..12 (12h) or
                    0..23 (24h), aria-valuenow = displayed hour,
                    aria-valuetext = "9" (12h) or "09" (24h), data-hour="HH"
- minute segment:   role=spinbutton, 0..59, aria-valuetext = "05",
                    data-minute="MM"
- meridiem segment: role=spinbutton, 0..1, aria-valuenow 0=AM 1=PM,
                    aria-valuetext = "AM"|"PM", data-meridiem="AM"|"PM"

## Listbox slot mode (optional)

attachSlotList(el) -> role=listbox; attachSlot(el, {hour, minute}) -> role=
option that selects that time on click. Selected slot carries
aria-selected="true" + data-selected. Segments are the priority surface; the
slot mode is a thin add on the same value state.

## Slot conventions (for <lite-time-picker>)

- [data-hour-segment]        -- the hour spinbutton
- [data-minute-segment]      -- the minute spinbutton
- [data-meridiem-segment]    -- the meridiem spinbutton (12h mode only)

## <lite-time-picker> attributes

- value                      -- "HH:MM" (24-hour); default 00:00
- hour12                     -- "true" | "false"; default locale-derived
- minute-step                -- integer >= 1; default 1
- aria-label                 -- group label

## Composition (docs-level, non-overlay)

To render the segments inside a dropdown, pair with createPopover exactly as
the datepicker pairs with a popover: the popover owns open/placement/dismiss,
this primitive owns the value + segment wiring. This module never imports the
overlay layers.

## Zero-GC notes

Two owned lite-signal nodes (hour + minute). destroy() SEALS both back into the
1024-node pool (H-12): reads freeze at the final value, writes no-op. Segment
spins are allocation-free -- the typeahead buffer is one reused object, the
reflection effect uses dirty-checked setAttr, and no per-event Intl call is
made (hour12 resolved once at construction).

## CSS contract

This primitive's painted attributes follow the canonical CSS contract in
`docs/CSS_CONTRACT.md`. See that doc for the cross-primitive taxonomy
(booleans like `data-selected`, ARIA pairings, host accessor naming, and event
naming).
